generation_prompts.wardrobe: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: horizontal 3:2 photograph-style illustration for a premium furniture ASSEMBLY SERVICE website. Documentary interior photography, authentic material imperfections, straight verticals, ordinary natural window light, high photographic realism; not a glossy CGI showroom. No people, no hands, no faces, no dressers, no sideboards, no chests of drawers, no text, no logos, no collage. Furniture assembly must be immediately obvious. All geometry, joints, tools and fasteners must be physically plausible. Scene: a high-quality European apartment with oak floor protected by felt. Main subject: a substantial floor-to-ceiling three-bay walnut veneered wardrobe CARCASS during installation, empty shelves and hanging rails visible. Two hinged full-height solid taupe doors already correctly mounted, a third matching full-height door lying flat on padded trestles in the foreground with concealed cup hinges fitted into its back. A small professional cordless driver and organized hardware tray sit on the floor close to the wardrobe. Focus on the large fitted wardrobe structure and precise assembly. No central island, no drawer chest. Wide three-quarter viewpoint, 35mm lens, restrained expensive materials.
